Pose - Formal Diplomatic Stance.description:
🕴️ Pose: Formal Diplomatic Stance
An upright, composed posture with hands clasped or at sides — formal, measured, and appropriate for official settings.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Formal Diplomatic Stance.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, use an upright formal posture with level chin, squared shoulders, and frame-visible hands clasped neatly, held behind the back, or resting flat at the sides without adding ceremonial props. Female: shoulders level, spine long, chin level. Male: shoulders squared, chest set, chin level. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own formal carriage.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
